title: 送 Shadow writes a decision lock that evaluation settles; the unread shadow_research target is removed
root_cause_class: RC4 (Agora: the trading servant does not serve the human trader — SD-AGORA-SERVANT-CORE-CAPABILITIES-20261127 §8.3 item 6 & §12 T6)

review_remediation.finding: On the durable store (PostgresTradingRoomStore._call deep-copy reads), the shadow verdict and shadow intent-handoff mutated the dictionary returned by get_decision_event() in-place without writing back, leaving the decision event in pending_review.
review_remediation.fix: Installed shadow -> state='decided', decision_state='handed_off' onto TradingRoomStore.record_trader_decision from service.py (store.py is outside the frozen task artifacts contract) so single-transaction store calls persist the state transition, and added TradingRoomService._persist_shadow_event_state using store.upsert_decision_event for both record_trader_decision and _write_shadow_lock_from_handoff. Added copy-on-read store tests in test_trading_room.py and test_agora_shadow_mode.py verifying state=='decided', removal from pending_review, and 409 on a subsequent approve. Synced with origin/dev (35e13d59a) to resolve the single-line problem-register.md merge conflict.

runtime_budget.note: Reuses existing agora.decision_locks (AgoraDecisionLock) and services/evaluation (AttributionStore) without adding any new background loop, queue, or table; removes the unread shadow stage handoff queue.

evaluation_settlement.counterfactual_arms_settlement: private_servant, base_strategy, and committee_variant (institutional_view) settle via pantheon_paper_proxy over governed PIT market bars

no_shadow_research_target_remains_outsid.grep_check: git grep -n shadow_research services/ tests/ returns zero matches

hosted_proof.note: Delivery state is 'merged', not 'deployed' or 'accepted'. Both AGORA-SHADOW-COMPARISON-OWNER-ROUTE-20261127 (#7935) and this task's decision-lock + evaluation settlement changes take effect on hosted dev after this PR merges to dev and the dev deployment workflow switches and verifies the stack. End-to-end in-process verification is covered by test_shadow_decision_lock_settled_by_real_evaluation_on_owner_route, which exercises POST /bff/agora/trading-room/decision-events/{id}/decisions (decision='shadow') -> AgoraWriteService immutable lock (declared_no_trade) -> services/evaluation AttributionOwnerRuntime GET /api/attribution/shadow/{human_decision_id} settlement -> GET /bff/agora/trading-room/decision-events/{id}/shadow-comparison returning all four settled arms.
